# Draft:Charles D. King

Charles D. King (born on July 30, 1969 Harlem) is an American film and television producer.
Life
He grew up in Decatur, Georgia. He graduated from Vanderbilt University and from Howard University School of Law.
He was an intern at MTV. He worked for  Champion International and America Online. He was a partner at William Morris Endeavor. He founded MACRO Film Studios.In 2015, King founded the production company Macro, which  focuses on promoting underrepresented writing talent. The company is financed by private investors. It also operates in management under the name M88.
He is a member of the  Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences and Academy of The Television Arts & Sciences.
Filmography
* Mudbound, 2017
* Roman J. Israel, Esq. 2017
* Sorry to Bother You, 2018
* Judas And The Black Messiah, 2021
* Young. Wild. Free. 2023
* They Cloned Tyrone, 2023
* The Scent of Burnt Flowers
